meta.prompt: Using Denodo view admin.pg_vessel_positions_select, for IMO 9282792 (CLYDE NOBLE), identify the top 5 longest AIS silence periods based on daily aggregate boundaries: compute one row per day with MIN(timestamp_date) and MAX(timestamp_date), then compare each day's MAX(timestamp_date) to the next AIS day's MIN(timestamp_date). Return only gaps longer than 6 hours. Include vesselname, imonumber, last_ais_before_gap, first_ais_after_gap, gap_duration_hours. Sort by duration descending. Return all rows.
